blocks.text: If you thought modern heavy music had run out of ways to completely shock the system, think again. Falling in Reverse frontman Ronnie Radke has never been one to play by the rules of the industry, but his latest single, “Joseph,” completely shatters the ceiling of expectations. Serving as a spiritual and literal successor to the chaotic masterpiece “Ronald,” this explosive anti-war metal epic is not just a song; it is a seismic cultural event for the heavy music landscape. Named after Radke’s own middle name, “Joseph” acts as a massive powder keg. It achieves what many music enthusiasts believed to […]...
